items.text: Follow one node through assignment, simulator creation, selection by scripts/xc and cleanup. Retry assignment reuses the node’s device. A missing destination is created or refused with the next step. Run scripts/plan-test.

Schedule two runnable UI nodes through the normal workflow. Verify distinct devices, the existing three-node cap, reuse of a free slot after serial work, and cleanup confined to the owning node. Run scripts/run-plan-test and scripts/plan-test.
